name: list_card_types
title: List card types
description:
Every type of card a flow can be built from, with a one-line summary. `category` narrows
it, and `categories` lists the values. `legacy: true` means it can no longer be added.

category.description: Return only the cards in one group. Must be one of the values in the `categories` key of this tool's own answer — call it once with no filter to see them.
